name: Z4-wanted-not-rebuilt
old: this._wanted = new Set();   // SLAM7: rebuilt every frame
new: this._wanted = this._wanted ?? new Set();   // SLAM7: rebuilt every frame

name: Z5-body-peer-wanted
old: if (bodyH > 0) { this._shown.push({ peer, height: bodyH }); continue; }
new: if (bodyH > 0) { this._wanted.add(lookKey(peer.look)); this._shown.push({ peer, height: bodyH }); continue; }

name: Z7-departed-batch-kept
Z8-worn-union-restored
new: _needed() { const out = new Set(this._wanted); for (const e of this._batches.values()) out.add(e.key); return out; }
why: the worn keys are a subset of the wanted set after every sync (the pinned invariant), so the union adds nothing - this is the redundancy B4 names, kept in the list as the proof of it
